answer_text: Downstream MTU is the lowest MTU discovered across all WAN links. With 1450 and 1383 bytes, the downstream MTU used will be 1383 bytes. Passive (backup) links do not change this calculation when links are active; the MTU is determined by the minimum discovered MTU across the WAN links, while passive backups affect traffic routing rather than the downstream MTU value.
